shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -c "rg --files | head -200 && printf '\\n--- styles ---\\n' && (ls -la app && rg -n \"globals|tailwind|css\" app package.json)"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,240p' lib/db.js && printf '\\n--- project notes ---\\n' && cat GEMINI.md && cat CLAUDE.md && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- cache docs ---\\n' && sed -n '1,230p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/caching.md"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,230p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md && printf '\\n--- use-cache directive ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md 2>/dev/null && printf '\\n--- cacheTag ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md && printf '\\n--- revalidateTag ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md && printf '\\n--- cache directive ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && printf '\\n--- cacheTag ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md && printf '\\n--- revalidateTag ---\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md && printf '\\n--- forms ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/forms.md && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"inline|inside.*Page|revalidateTag\\(.*'max'|cacheLife\\('hours'\\)|cacheLife\\('minutes'\\)\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/server-actions.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/forms.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/08-caching.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md | head -100 && printf '\\n--- catalog context and style files ---\\n' && find app -maxdepth 2 -type f -print"
